blocks.text: Acreage and rural land in Campbell Valley

items.t: Fee-simple acreage parcels: a Campbell Valley parcel is fee-simple unless title shows otherwise — no strata, no Form B, no strata fees on the parcel itself; Township zoning, ALR status (where applicable) and registered charges govern.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect acreage buyers in Campbell Valley

items.t: Township zoning: Township of Langley Zoning Bylaw 2500 governs this ground.

blocks.text: Good to know about Campbell Valley

items.t: The park is regional, and horses are in its mandate: Campbell Valley Regional Park is a Metro Vancouver regional park whose trail network serves horseback riders alongside walkers and cyclists — the infrastructure behind the sub-area's equestrian framing.

faq.q: How many results does this page's feed show, and is that a market figure?
faq.a: The page text read for this file shows "1-12 / 47" — a live-feed snapshot, not a market statistic. Campbell Valley's published sub-area inventory for September 2026 was 16 detached listings, a different measure from a different source (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats).

faq.q: Is this the same page as campbell-valley?
faq.a: No — they are two distinct pages. This file covers campbell-valley-acreages-farms-for-sale, the acreages/farms topic feed; campbell-valley is the separate area/homes page, with its own batch-15 research file.

faq.q: What is the ALR and does it apply to farms in Campbell Valley?
faq.a: The Agricultural Land Reserve is farmland protected by the provincial Agricultural Land Commission. Farm use is generally allowed on ALR land, but subdividing, adding homes or using the land for non-farm purposes usually needs approval, so check a property's ALR status before you offer.

faq.q: What should I check before buying a farm in Campbell Valley?
faq.a: Check the ALR status, water source and licences, drainage and flood history, the buildings and any quota or production licences that do or do not transfer with the land. Poultry and egg production in BC are supply-managed, so a sale of the farm does not automatically include quota.

faq.q: Can I convert a Campbell Valley acreage to bare-land strata?
faq.a: No strata conversion is verified for any parcel here, and on ALR ground depositing a strata plan IS a subdivision and needs ALC permission (Bulletin 09 s.6).

faq.q: Which schools serve a Campbell Valley address?
faq.a: unconfirmed as catchments — Brookswood Secondary, Langley Fundamental Elementary and Langley Secondary are Ministry-listed SD35 schools named for wider-area context only, and no locator run for a Campbell Valley address is on record. Run the exact address with the district.

faq.q: When are Township of Langley property taxes due?
faq.a: Thursday, July 2, 2026, with a 5% penalty at midnight July 2, 2026 and an additional 5% at midnight September 3, 2026.
